summary: HTTPSettings — settings for HTTP/HTTPS storage via httpx. Supports read (GET), write (PUT), and metadata (HEAD). Accepts Bearer and Basic auth. HTTP_SPEC captures sdk_package='httpx'. Covers both http:// and https:// schemes.
lifecycle_notes: Added in Phase 5 (2026-05-07 HTTP backend plan). Evolving: multipart upload not yet implemented.
documentation_hooks: Document that write is via PUT (not POST) — not all HTTP servers support PUT
Bearer and Basic auth both supported — configure via auth= argument
risks: PUT semantics differ from POST — servers must explicitly support PUT for writes
open_questions: Multipart upload support for large files is not yet implemented
